note: New entries only. All untested. evidence_label: EVIDENCE/CRAFT/DERIVED. Product rule: never change a real product's structure, material, colour or shape.

lighting_setups.name: AR residual-colour reveal
lighting_setups.purpose: Show that a lens is AR-coated by letting one controlled reflection display the coating's real residual colour.
lighting_setups.how: Black seamless background, frame at 0-10 deg yaw on black acrylic. Main: 30x120 cm stripbox placed INSIDE the lens's family of angles - roughly on the camera axis side, 20-30 deg off-axis horizontally and 10-15 deg above lens height, 60-80 cm away - so it paints one narrow reflection on each lens. Fill for the frame: large softbox 90 deg camera-left, high (45 deg), outside the family of angles, black flag between it and the lenses. Ratio frame:background ~4:1; lens reflection 1-2 stops under frame highlight. Rotate frame 5 deg at a time to move hue along the reflection (thin-film colour shifts with angle).
lighting_setups.limits: Residual colour must match the real lens spec (green/blue/violet); uncoated lenses show white reflection instead. Strong reflection hides eyes in on-face shots - product only.
lighting_setups.evidence_label: DERIVED from thin-film/Fresnel physics + CRAFT family of angles

lighting_setups.name: Cross-polarized catalogue flat
lighting_setups.purpose: Remove nearly all specular glare from lenses and glossy acetate for cutouts and colour-true catalogue images.
lighting_setups.how: Two softboxes at +-45 deg, 30 deg above the frame, 70 cm away, each covered with linear polarizer film in the same orientation. Circular/linear polarizer on the lens rotated until highlights vanish (perpendicular). White or grey seamless 1 stop over the frame for easy cutout. Ratio 1.5:1 left:right. Then optionally blend in a second, non-polarized exposure at 20-30% to restore a faint lens presence (house rule: lenses must not look empty).
lighting_setups.limits: Kills the material cues (gloss, metal reflections) - metal can look flat grey; costs ~1.5-2 stops; birefringent plastics may show stress colours between polarizers (DERIVED, unverified). Never ship as the only image of a metal frame.

lighting_setups.name: Overhead flat-lay with scrim and black camera card
lighting_setups.purpose: Top-down 1:1 flat-lay where the lenses reflect a controlled dark card instead of the camera and ceiling.
lighting_setups.how: Camera straight down (90 deg) over the frame on a textured surface. 120x120 cm diffusion scrim 70-90 cm above the table, tilted 10-15 deg toward camera-top, lit through by one strobe/LED from above-behind. Cut a hole for the lens or hang a 30x40 cm black card around the camera so the lenses (which face the camera) mirror black. White card low at the bottom edge as fill. Ratio top:bottom ~2:1. Fold temples or tilt frame 5-10 deg so the lens reflection shows a gradient from scrim to black.
lighting_setups.limits: Large scrim reflection may wash over the lens if the frame lies flat; props near the frame show in metal reflections.

lighting_setups.name: On-face twin high strips
lighting_setups.purpose: Light a person wearing glasses with clear eyes and no lens hotspots, keeping a faint believable lens reflection.
lighting_setups.how: Two 30x120 cm stripboxes vertical at +-60 deg from the camera axis, centres 40 deg above eye line, 1.2 m from face, feathered forward. Large white bounce or 1x1 m panel at chest height on axis as fill (2 stops under key -> ~4:1 when one strip is lowered, 2:1 for beauty). Subject chin down 3-5 deg; temples tilted slightly. Hair/back light 150 deg high for separation. Check every lens: reflection must sit at the lens edge or off frame.
lighting_setups.limits: Very wraparound lenses or high-curve sport frames still catch a strip; heavy minus lenses show thick edge rings regardless.

lighting_setups.name: Mirror-lens scene reflection design
lighting_setups.purpose: Treat a mirror-coated sun lens as a mirror: design what it reflects (sky, sea, gradient card) rather than lighting the lens.
lighting_setups.how: Decide the reflection first: outdoors, frame faces open sky/sea with sun 30-60 deg to one side so the lens shows horizon line + sky gradient; in studio, hang a 1x1.5 m gradient card (light top to dark bottom, or brand colour) 1-1.5 m in front of the frame just above the camera, lit by a separate light. Camera and crew in black or hidden behind the card. Light the frame body separately from the side (90 deg, high) with flags keeping that light out of the lens.
lighting_setups.limits: Mirror colour must stay true to the product; reflections of identifiable people/brands must be avoided.

lighting_setups.name: Metal wire edge strips
lighting_setups.purpose: Draw continuous bright lines along thin metal or rimless frames so their thin geometry reads against the background.
lighting_setups.how: Dark or mid-grey background. Two narrow stripboxes (15x90 cm, gridded) behind-left and behind-right at 120-150 deg from camera, at frame height, 50-70 cm away, so their mirror images run along the rims and temples. Small front fill (white card or 60 cm softbox above camera, 2-3 stops under the edge lines). Black flags just outside the frame edges to give the opposite side of each wire a dark line. Adjust strip height until the highlight line runs unbroken along the rim.
lighting_setups.limits: Gold-plated metal shows warm lines (correct), do not neutralise; matte-coated metal shows soft sheen not lines.

lighting_setups.name: Tinted-lens hard-sun shadow
lighting_setups.purpose: Use real hard sun (or a bare fresnel) to cast coloured lens shadows and caustics as a summer graphic.
lighting_setups.how: Frame on a plain light surface (sand-coloured card, white plaster). Sun or bare LED/fresnel at 25-35 deg elevation, 90-120 deg from camera so shadows fall long across the frame. No fill or only a small white card (ratio 8:1+). Gradient/tinted lenses throw coloured transmitted light; plus lenses focus a bright spot inside the shadow, minus lenses darken the centre. Shoot within the short golden window at Hua Hin (~25 min for 0-6 deg) or between 08:00-09:00 for crisper light.
lighting_setups.limits: Only works with genuine hard light; clear lenses give faint caustics only. Colour of shadow must come from the real lens tint.

lighting_setups.name: Acetate light-pad transillumination
lighting_setups.purpose: Reveal the depth and amber layers of tortoiseshell or coloured translucent acetate.
lighting_setups.how: Place the frame front on a frosted acrylic sheet over an LED light pad (5000-5600 K) or a strobe firing up through diffusion. Background light 0.5-1 stop over the frame front exposure. Weak top key (60 cm softbox, 45 deg above, 1-2 stops under the backlight) to keep the surface gloss and edges. Black cards along the sides to outline the outer edge (dark-field edge) - keep the main look bright-field; do not mix both strongly.
lighting_setups.limits: Opaque acetate and metal parts go black; colour shifts if the pad is not neutral.

lighting_setups.name: Tropical open shade with sand bounce
lighting_setups.purpose: Flattering portraits with glasses under harsh Hua Hin midday sun without studio gear.
lighting_setups.how: Subject 0.5-1 m inside the edge of a deep shade (awning, building, tree line) facing out toward open bright sky; sun behind the shade-maker. Key = bright sky (huge soft source in front, ~30-60 deg elevation); fill = sunlit sand/pavement in front bouncing up (warm). Keep ratio ~2:1. Black card or dark wall on one side for shape. Check lenses: the bright sky band will mirror on the upper lens - chin down slightly.
lighting_setups.limits: Sand bounce lights the lower lens edge; very deep shade goes blue-cyan (sky-only light) - warm in grading.
use_for: AI scene prompts set in Hua Hin

lighting_setups.name: Beach noon overhead silk
lighting_setups.purpose: Turn overhead tropical noon sun into soft light on a person at the beach while keeping the bright sea background.
lighting_setups.how: 2x2 m full-stop silk 60-100 cm above the head, tilted toward the sun so the subject stays fully in its shade; sandbags or two assistants (wind). Silver/white reflector 1 m low in front at 30 deg below eye line for fill (2:1). Expose for skin; background sea/sky 1-2 stops brighter - acceptable airy look; add ND to keep shallow focus.
lighting_setups.limits: Wind; the silk's edge must not show as a hard line on the face; reflections of the silk appear in lenses as a soft panel (acceptable).

lighting_setups.name: Book light soft key
lighting_setups.purpose: Very soft yet directional key for interviews and faces with glasses; large source reduces specular intensity on lenses.
lighting_setups.how: Hard source (LED/fresnel) aimed into a 1.2x1.2 m white bounce board; a 1.2-2 m frame of diffusion (silk or grid cloth) placed parallel to the board, 30-60 cm in front of it, forming an open-book shape. Whole unit at 45 deg from camera, centre 30-40 deg above eye line, 1-1.5 m from face. Negative fill (black flag) on the far side for 3:1-4:1. Keep the source high to keep its lens reflection off the eyes.
lighting_setups.limits: Needs space and power (double loss); gap too large creates hotspots.

lighting_setups.name: Raking texture light
lighting_setups.purpose: Reveal surface texture (wood grain, stone, fabric, embossed packaging, acetate lamination edges).
lighting_setups.how: Single point or narrow slit source at 5-15 deg above the surface plane, from one side; no fill or a tiny card (ratio 8:1+). Camera roughly perpendicular to the surface. Make a second frame from 90 deg rotated light direction - features parallel to the beam disappear.
lighting_setups.limits: Exaggerates dust and scratches on glossy products; useless on mirror-like surfaces (reflects or misses entirely).
use_for: wood/stone scene textures for AI references

lighting_setups.name: Dusk shopfront interior-exterior balance
lighting_setups.purpose: Photograph or prompt the shop exterior when the twilight sky and the lit interior have similar brightness.
lighting_setups.how: Shoot during civil twilight (sun 0 to -6 deg), the short window at Hua Hin's latitude; meter sky vs interior and press the shutter when within ~1 stop. Interior practicals 3000-4000 K, white balance ~4500-5000 K so the sky goes blue and the interior warm. Camera on tripod at eye height, verticals straight. Optional: one hidden soft light on the sign.
lighting_setups.limits: Window lasts only minutes in the tropics; mixed LED colour casts show on product shelves.

lighting_setups.name: Shop window daylight + ceiling LED
lighting_setups.purpose: Natural-looking interior light for the real eyewear shop with controlled lens reflections.
lighting_setups.how: Key: shop window/door daylight at 60-90 deg to the subject (side light), diffused with a sheer curtain if sun hits. Ambient: ceiling LED panels 4000 K (set camera WB ~5000 K so window stays neutral and LEDs slightly warm). Fill: white foam board on the shadow side (3:1). Black card/flag above the camera to kill the ceiling panels' reflections on lenses and display glass. Turn off or flag any LED strip that appears in lenses.
lighting_setups.limits: Mixed colour temperatures; overhead panels create raccoon eyes on staff if used as key.

lighting_setups.name: Leaf backlight translucency
lighting_setups.purpose: Make foliage glow through subsurface transmission - calm nature shots for eye-break clips.
lighting_setups.how: Sun or strong light behind the leaves at 150-180 deg from camera, 10-40 deg elevation; camera in the leaves' shadow or with a flag/lens hood to avoid flare. Expose for the glowing leaves; background in shade 2-3 stops darker. Morning in Hua Hin (sun from the sea side, east).
lighting_setups.limits: Flare veils contrast; dense dark leaves do not transmit much.

lighting_setups.name: Charcoal three-value light plan
lighting_setups.purpose: A light plan for the pencil/charcoal Mint & Tao carousels that reads form with minimal tones.
lighting_setups.how: Choose one key direction per scene (e.g. upper-left 45 deg). Three values only: paper white (lit planes and highlights), one mid hatch (halftones + reflected light, never darker than the shadow), one dark (form + cast shadows). Model the lights, keep shadows flat (Gurney rule). Darkest accents only at occlusion contacts (feet on ground, cup on table) and a light core along the terminator. Cast shadows sharp near contact, softer away. Background planes one value lighter (aerial perspective).
lighting_setups.limits: Faceless characters lose expression cues if shadows cover the head; keep heads mostly in light.

lighting_setups.name: Product caustic projection
lighting_setups.purpose: Project moving water caustics onto the set behind/under the glasses for a summer, sea-side mood.
lighting_setups.how: Clear glass tray with 2-3 cm of water above or in front of the set; one hard source (bare LED/fresnel or sun) shining through it at 30-60 deg onto the backdrop/table; disturb the water for movement in video. Frame lit separately by a soft key from the opposite side (45 deg, high) with flags keeping caustics off the lenses if they confuse the lens read. Background caustics 0.5-1 stop over base backdrop.
lighting_setups.limits: Soft sources produce no crisp caustics; water near electrics; caustics on lenses can look like damage.

atmospheric_effects.name: Crepuscular rays
atmospheric_effects.purpose: Sunbeams through cloud gaps for awe/hope beats.
atmospheric_effects.how: Rays converge toward the sun's position (even off frame); bright beams alternate with cloud-shadow bands; require visible haze overall; strongest with sun low behind cumulus.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: crepuscular rays fanning from behind cumulus clouds over the sea, hazy air
atmospheric_effects.limits: Parallel rays in wide shots are wrong; rays in crystal-clear air are wrong.

atmospheric_effects.name: Anticrepuscular rays
atmospheric_effects.purpose: Rare beams converging opposite the sun at sunset.
atmospheric_effects.how: Camera faces away from the low sun; faint rays converge to the antisolar point on the opposite horizon.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: faint anticrepuscular rays converging on the eastern horizon at sunset

atmospheric_effects.name: Aerial perspective layering
atmospheric_effects.how: 3-4 depth layers: near full contrast; each farther layer raises blacks and lowers saturation, shifting to the sky colour; exponential not linear; keep the product in clear air.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: distant islands fading in layers into pale blue haze, foreground crisp
atmospheric_effects.limits: Dust haze should be white-grey-yellow, not blue.

atmospheric_effects.name: Tropical noon haze
atmospheric_effects.how: Overhead sun, short cast shadows, white-pale sky near the horizon, deeper blue only overhead; shadows filled by bright sky (not black).
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: harsh tropical midday sun, short shadows, pale hazy horizon, humid air
atmospheric_effects.limits: Harsh on faces - use shade/silk setups for people.

atmospheric_effects.name: Backlit sea-spray haze
atmospheric_effects.how: Morning sun over the sea (east) behind subject 150-180 deg; humid salt aerosol forward-scatters into a warm glowing veil; horizon a soft white band.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: backlit morning sea spray glowing in warm haze along the Hua Hin shoreline
atmospheric_effects.limits: Flare reduces contrast; keep glasses lit from front with bounce.

atmospheric_effects.name: Dry-season smoke haze
atmospheric_effects.how: Milky yellow-white sky, low contrast distance, sun turns orange-red before reaching the horizon.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: milky yellow haze, pale orange sun low in a smoky sky
atmospheric_effects.limits: Evidence is for northern Thailand only.

atmospheric_effects.name: Morning fog / mist
atmospheric_effects.how: Neutral white-grey, equal across colours; visibility tens to hundreds of metres; objects fade to fog colour; backlight makes fog glow, frontlight flattens it.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: soft morning mist, trees fading to grey-white in layers
atmospheric_effects.limits: Rare at Hua Hin beach; use for inland hills or story worlds.

atmospheric_effects.name: Dust motes in a light beam
atmospheric_effects.how: Hard window beam into a darker room, camera looking toward the light so motes forward-scatter; motes vanish when light is behind camera.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: a shaft of window light with floating dust motes in a dim optical shop
atmospheric_effects.limits: Dust on products looks dirty - keep motes in the air away from lenses.

atmospheric_effects.name: Thin smoke layer
atmospheric_effects.how: Thin smoke looks slightly bluish against dark backgrounds and warmer when seen toward the light (DERIVED small-particle scattering).
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: thin bluish smoke drifting across a dark street lit by a warm lamp

atmospheric_effects.name: Rain streaks
atmospheric_effects.how: Backlight the rain; streak length = exposure time (fast shutter dots, slow streaks); shallow depth of field blurs near drops; wet ground mirrors practicals.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: backlit rain streaks against a dark street, wet asphalt reflecting neon

atmospheric_effects.name: Still-water reflection
atmospheric_effects.how: Reflection vertically below; light tones reflect slightly darker; near-mirror only at grazing view; looking down shows the bottom; ripples elongate light sources vertically into glitter paths.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: calm water reflecting the shophouses slightly darker, ripples stretching the lamp reflections
atmospheric_effects.limits: Exact flipped copy is wrong when camera is above water.

atmospheric_effects.name: Shallow coastal sea colour
atmospheric_effects.how: Near shore pale green-turquoise with sandy suspended sediment; bluer with depth (red absorbed over metres); sky reflection dominates at grazing angles.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: pale green-turquoise shallow sea with sandy tones near the shore
atmospheric_effects.limits: Avoid deep-ocean cobalt for Hua Hin claims.

atmospheric_effects.name: Tropical golden hour (short)
atmospheric_effects.how: Sun 0-6 deg lasts ~25-27 min; long shadows, warm direct light, cool shadows; at Hua Hin beach the golden hour faces the sea in the morning.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: low warm morning sun rising over the Gulf of Thailand, long shadows across the sand
atmospheric_effects.limits: AI images must match long shadows to the low sun.

atmospheric_effects.name: Blue-hour shopfront
atmospheric_effects.how: Civil twilight; sky deep blue, interiors warm; balance within ~1 stop.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: optical shop at blue hour, deep blue sky and warm glowing windows

atmospheric_effects.name: Moonlit night (convention)
atmospheric_effects.how: Low-saturation cool ambience (Purkinje convention), warm saturated practicals, rim separation; never show a bright sky in day-for-night.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: moonlit night with cool desaturated ambience and a single warm lamp in the shop window
atmospheric_effects.limits: Blue moonlight is perceptual/convention, not physics.

atmospheric_effects.name: Storm sky over bright sea
atmospheric_effects.how: Dark cumulonimbus overhead with sunlit sea or beach under a cloud gap; rain shafts in distance; crepuscular rays possible.
atmospheric_effects.prompt_phrase: dark storm clouds over the Gulf with a sunlit patch on the sea and distant rain shafts
